label: FRED macro series (CSV)
data_kinds: macro series (policy rates, yields, curve slopes, credit spreads, inflation expectations, activity data)

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: FRED API key ('32 character alpha-numeric lowercase string') requested at https://fredaccount.stlouisfed.org/apikeys; sent as the api_key query parameter (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html). Terms: show 'This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.'

adapter.rate_note: No numeric limit on the pages read; the terms of use say the Bank 'may impose or adjust the limit on … the number of transactions you may send or receive' and forbid 'an unreasonable amount of bandwidth' (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/terms_of_use.html). A missing/invalid key answers HTTP 400 {error_code, error_message}. Base https://api.stlouisfed.org is the documented JSON API (the survey's base_urls list the keyless fredgraph.csv export the collector scrapes).

me.note: FRED has no account endpoint: the key is verified by fetching the docs' own example series (GET /fred/series?series_id=GNPCA); account carries realtime_start/end and seriess[].

get_series.note: `start`/`end` are observation_start/observation_end (YYYY-MM-DD); the API's own limit (1-100,000, default 100,000) and offset are not exposed, so one call returns the full range. `value` is the documented numeric string ('.' marks a missing observation); units (lin), frequency and aggregation_method keep FRED's defaults. realtime_start/realtime_end stay in `raw`.

search_symbols.note: Full-text search (search_type=full_text default) ordered by search_rank; limit 1-1000 with offset paging and `count` as the total. `type` is the series frequency (e.g. Monthly); units, seasonal_adjustment, observation_start/end, popularity and last_updated stay in `raw`.

not_offered.get_candles: FRED serves observations (one value per date), not OHLC candles — use get_series.
not_offered.get_news: No news endpoint on this API.

evidence: host api.stlouisfed.org: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
